---
title: "Utilities"
---

Core format conversion, FCS I/O, and channel classification functions.

## `sw_io_read_fcs` {#sw_io_read_fcs}

Read FCS files with Aurora-safe defaults.

### Usage

```r
sw_io_read_fcs(files, ...)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `files` | Character vector of FCS file paths. |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `flowCore::read.FCS()` or `flowCore::read.flowSet()`. |

### Details

Wrapper around `flowCore::read.FCS()` or `flowCore::read.flowSet()` with
`truncate_max_range = FALSE` enforced. This is required for Cytek Aurora data
because fluorescence intensities (~4×10⁶) exceed flowCore's default range
cutoffs.

### Value

A `flowFrame` (single file) or `flowSet` (multiple files).

---

## `sw_io_ff_to_tibble` {#sw_io_ff_to_tibble}

Convert a flowFrame to a tibble.

### Usage

```r
sw_io_ff_to_tibble(ff, sample = NULL, batch = NULL, condition = NULL)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ff` | A `flowCore::flowFrame` object. |
| `sample` | Optional character string — sample identifier appended as a column. |
| `batch` | Optional character string — batch label appended as a column. |
| `condition` | Optional character string — condition label appended as a column. |

### Details

Extracts the expression matrix from a `flowFrame` and returns it as a tibble
with optional metadata columns for sample ID, batch, and condition.

### Value

A `tibble` with one row per cell and one column per channel, plus metadata
columns if specified.

---

## `sw_io_tibble_to_ff` {#sw_io_tibble_to_ff}

Convert a tibble to a flowFrame.

### Usage

```r
sw_io_tibble_to_ff(df, markers = NULL)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `df` | A `data.frame` or `tibble`. |
| `markers` | Optional character vector of column names to include as channels. If `NULL`, all numeric columns are used. |

### Details

Converts a tibble (or data.frame) into a `flowCore::flowFrame`. Only the
specified marker columns are included in the expression matrix; metadata
columns are dropped.

### Value

A `flowCore::flowFrame`.

---

## `sw_io_exprs_to_tibble` {#sw_io_exprs_to_tibble}

Convert an expression matrix to a tibble.

### Usage

```r
sw_io_exprs_to_tibble(mat, colnames = NULL, sample = NULL, batch = NULL,
                   condition = NULL)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `mat` | A numeric matrix (cells in rows, channels in columns). |
| `colnames` | Optional character vector of column names. |
| `sample` | Optional character string — sample identifier. |
| `batch` | Optional character string — batch label. |
| `condition` | Optional character string — condition label. |

### Details

Converts a numeric matrix to a tibble with optional metadata columns. Useful
for converting output from `flowCore::exprs()` or similar matrix-returning
functions.

### Value

A `tibble`.

---

## `sw_channel_get_fluor` {#sw_channel_get_fluor}

Get fluorescent channel names.

### Usage

```r
sw_channel_get_fluor(ff_or_fs)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ff_or_fs` | A `flowFrame` or `flowSet`. |

### Details

Returns the names of fluorescent/marker channels, excluding scatter (FSC/SSC)
and Time channels.

### Value

Character vector of fluorescent channel names.

---

## `sw_channel_set_markers` {#sw_channel_set_markers}

Set marker names on a flowFrame.

### Usage

```r
sw_channel_set_markers(ff, marker_map)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ff` | A `flowCore::flowFrame`. |
| `marker_map` | A named character vector mapping channel names to marker names. |

### Details

Renames channel descriptions (markers) on a `flowFrame` according to the
supplied mapping.

### Value

The modified `flowFrame` with updated marker names.

---

## `sw_channel_is_signal` {#sw_channel_is_signal}

Identify signal columns.

### Usage

```r
sw_channel_is_signal(
  x,
  exclude_patterns = c("Time", "Original_ID", "File", "SampleID")
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `x` | A `flowFrame` or `flowSet`. |
| `exclude_patterns` | Character vector of patterns to exclude. |

### Details

Returns a logical vector indicating which columns represent true signal
(not metadata columns like Time, Original_ID, File, SampleID). Ported from
CytoPipeline (UCLouvain-CBIO).

### Value

A named logical vector with length equal to `ncol(x)`.

---

## `sw_channel_is_fluor` {#sw_channel_is_fluor}

Identify fluorochrome columns.

### Usage

```r
sw_channel_is_fluor(
  x,
  exclude_patterns = c("FSC", "SSC", "Time", "Original_ID", "File", "SampleID")
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `x` | A `flowFrame` or `flowSet`. |
| `exclude_patterns` | Character vector of patterns to exclude (includes scatter channels). |

### Details

Returns a logical vector indicating which columns represent fluorochrome
channels (excludes scatter channels, time, and metadata). Ported from
CytoPipeline (UCLouvain-CBIO).

### Value

A named logical vector with length equal to `ncol(x)`.

---

## `sw_io_subsample` {#sw_io_subsample}

Aggregate and subsample multiple flow frames.

### Usage

```r
sw_io_subsample(
  fs,
  n_total_events,
  setup = c("forceNEvent", "forceBalance"),
  seed = NULL,
  channels = NULL,
  keep_order = FALSE
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `fs` | A `flowSet`. |
| `n_total_events` | Target total number of events. |
| `setup` | Sampling strategy: `"forceNEvent"` (forced total count) or `"forceBalance"` (equal events per file). |
| `seed` | Optional random seed for reproducibility. |
| `channels` | Optional character vector of channels to include. |
| `keep_order` | Logical; whether to preserve event order within files. |

### Details

Pools events from multiple `flowFrame` objects in a `flowSet` and subsamples
to a target total. Ported from CytoPipeline (UCLouvain-CBIO).

### Value

A single `flowCore::flowFrame` with aggregated events.

---

## `sw_io_event_audit` {#sw_io_event_audit}

Collect events retained at each pipeline step.

### Usage

```r
sw_io_event_audit(intermediates)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `intermediates` | A named list of intermediate results (each a `flowFrame`, `flowSet`, or list of `flowFrame`s). |

### Details

Returns a summary tibble showing how many events were retained at each step,
providing a full audit trail of event filtering across the pipeline.

### Value

A `tibble` with columns: `step`, `n_events`, `pct_of_initial`,
`pct_of_previous`.
